name: Medallion
description: Medallion is a modern healthcare operations platform that automates provider credentialing, licensing, and payer enrollment. Built with a developer-first API approach, Medallion combines software automation with a managed services team to handle the end-to-end credentialing lifecycle. The platform is particularly popular with digital health companies, telehealth providers, and fast-growing healthcare organizations that need to scale provider networks quickly.
short_description: Modern credentialing platform automating provider licensing, payer enrollment, and primary source verification for digital health companies.
one_liner: End-to-end credentialing automation with API-first infrastructure

pricing.notes: Medallion offers both software-only and managed services options. Pricing varies significantly based on services needed, volume, and whether using API/platform access. Volume discounts available. Implementation typically included.

company.description: Medallion is a venture-backed healthcare operations platform founded to modernize provider credentialing and licensing through automation and API-first infrastructure.

compliance.notes: Medallion maintains SOC 2 Type II certification and is HIPAA compliant. While not NCQA CVO accredited themselves, they work with NCQA-accredited partners for delegated credentialing needs.

best_for: Behavioral health platforms scaling provider networks
Organizations with developer resources for integrations

Organizations requiring NCQA CVO accreditation from vendor
